levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: Needs ruling (rule 11): the Imam is named as the speaker only inside a narrated encounter («أن رجلاً قام إلى أمير المؤمنين … فقال له»); written as the last link, not settled.
«أبي» and «أبيه» after «سمعت» and «يحدث عن» are named only by relation: no name is supplied, none is completed.
«قالا» joins the two co-transmitters at the first level; «رضي الله عنهما» is a blessing and is left out.
